Hi Aisha,

Thanks for taking this. RidgeBank is beginning our annual SOC2 readiness assessment and the external auditor asked for a compact evidence bundle focused on access control. At minimum they want:
- SAML assertion samples for interactive logins (nameid, attributes)
- A recent SCIM delta export showing user create/update/deactivate events (last 30 days)
- RBAC mapping or role snapshot showing owner assignments and least-privilege rationale for service accounts
- A short summary of how you handle delegated admin / just-in-time elevation

Can you confirm what you can provide this week and whether we need a short call to go over redactions? Our deadline for delivery to the auditor is COB 2026-09-17.

Appreciate it — Emily

- SAML assertion samples: yes, we can provide three sanitized examples (interactive, API-SSO, and expired assertion). Karthik will attach the samples and explain fields we cannot share verbatim.

Proposed workback: we produce a draft bundle by 2026-09-14 EOD, you review for redactions on 9/15, final delivery 9/16. If that works I will flag the artifacts as high-priority and attach the sample outputs to this thread. Do you want a 30-minute walk-through on 9/15 morning?

Attaching the technical artifacts per Aisha's plan. Notes embedded below; attachments are: scim-delta-sample.csv, saml-assertion-example.txt, rbac-mapping-20260911.pdf.

--- scim-delta-sample.csv (attached) ---
Columns: event_id, timestamp, operation, user_id_hash, email_hash, external_tenant_id, source, actor_id
- We hash emails for external tenants (sha256 truncated) and keep tenant IDs so auditor can correlate multi-tenant behavior.
- Deactivations include reason codes; we can add last_login attr if auditor needs it.

--- saml-assertion-example.txt (attached) ---
- Sanitized: nameid replaced with <REDACTED>, attributes trimmed to show mapping names (email, roles, tenant_id).
- Note: we never include raw session tokens in assertions.

--- rbac-mapping-20260911.pdf (attached) ---
- Role snapshot exported from our IAM service: role id, role name, permissions list (coarse), owner (internal), typical principal type (user/service).
- Service accounts flagged; we provide short justifications for any role with write/delete perms.

Redaction policy: we will remove PII for third-party tenants and preserve auditability (timestamps, operation types, role ids). If RidgeBank prefers full identifiers for their own tenant only, confirm and we will produce a tenant-specific export.

Marissa: can you add the JIT/elevation summary and confirmation of SIEM retention windows? I'll bundle everything into the checklist workbook.

-Karthik
Platform Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
